_comment: Pinned upstream digests for the Xray routing engine's Linux assets.
Same trust model as scripts/linux-sidecar-pins.json: the archive digests come
from the asset metadata GitHub reports through the releases API for tag
v26.3.27 (a different source from the release's own .dgst files), and the
'binary' digests are the SHA-256 of the extracted executables, derived and
re-checked by the fetch script. The extracted binary's digest is the value
src-tauri/src/routing.rs's XRAY_SHA256 refuses to launch without.
Aether itself ships no glibc-2.34+ guarantee for its desktop binaries, but the
static musl core removes that concern for the core. Xray's upstream Linux
binaries are glibc-linked; the fetch script cannot prove the host toolchain,
so record the pinned binary digest and let the build-time Rust checks own the
Updating the engine means changing its version and every digest in one
reviewed commit together with XRAY_VERSION / XRAY_SHA256 in routing.rs.
